notes.title: 12/23, 2023 Alpha 20.1 Hotfix
notes.content:
This is a hotfix for a critical bug related to saving.

* Fixed a bug where loading gave an error after saving in random local maps or Puppy Caves.
* Changed the default frame limit setting to 60 FPS.
* Adjusted to make it harder to get tired.
* Containers can no longer be stolen from NPCs.
* When rerolling a character's background, changing race and other features will not change the parents.
* Fixed a glitch where doors in the tile where the character is located were closed upon game load.
* Fixed a glitch where the close button for Trail of Journey was unresponsive.
* Fixed a glitch where some Japanese fonts were not displayed.

[Other]
* Loytel being treated as a pet by Fiama is intentional.
* The fact that the gold bars sent from Mysilia are made of copper is intentional.
